placements.why: Nothing in the supplied strata (currently empty) or graph structure covers organizational content about test/QA evidence tied to closing a specific production defect. src-1 and src-2 together describe a test case whose entire point is proving a prod failure is reproduced and then correctly handled — an evidentiary/validation category, not a strategy or opportunity theme. Minting the top-level Proof stratum gives this and future test-evidence content a home; no existing category is even close enough for INSPIRED lineage since strata is empty.
placements.title: Evidence that closes a known production defect
placements.frame: what production failure does this artifact demonstrate is closed, and by what correctness bar?

placements.title: A named production failure pattern becomes a repeatable, must-pass test case
placements.frame: what specific production failure is being reproduced here, and what non-negotiable outcome must the fix demonstrate instead of it?
placements.why: src-1 names the exact prod failure pattern being reproduced (## level heading, no id field) and src-2 states the pass/fail bar the reproduction must clear (no crash, valid slug) — read together they describe one recurring theme: turning a known production defect into a durable regression check with a fixed correctness contract. No existing leaf holds this (graph structure is empty), and it is close enough to the newly minted Proof stratum to sit directly under it as the theme's first concrete instance, so it is placed there rather than left standalone.
